english.note: Use 爺爺 as the all-purpose everyday term for a paternal grandfather.

exampleSentences.english: My grandfather often takes me for dim sum.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我爺爺成日帶我去飲茶。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 je4 je4 seng4 jat6 daai3 ngo5 heoi3 jam2 caa4

english.note: Use 爺爺 for your father's father; your mother's father is 公公.

exampleSentences.english: My grandpa used to take me for dim sum all the time.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我爺爺以前成日帶我去飲茶。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 je4 je4 ji5 cin4 seng4 jat6 daai3 ngo5 heoi3 jam2 caa4

english.note: This is the usual word for a paternal grandfather and the best everyday choice when the family side is clear or unspecified.

exampleSentences.english: When I was little, I often went to the park with my granddad.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我細個嗰陣成日同爺爺去公園。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 sing4 jat6 tung4 je4 je4 heoi3 gung1 jyun4
